examples.arabic: إحنا كنا مبسوطين أوي وعدينا الفلوس مع بعض في الأوضة.
examples.english: We were very happy and counted the money together in the room.
examples.transliteration: ehna kona mabsoteen awy wa adenna el felous maa baad fe el oda.
examples.storyTitle: The Joy of Eid with the Family

examples.english: The seller agreed and I paid the money.
examples.transliteration: el bayaa wafeq wa ana dafaat el feloos

examples.arabic: هو دور في جيوبه، بس ملقاش فلوس كتير.
examples.english: He searched in his pockets, but he did not find much money.
examples.transliteration: Howa dawwar fee giyoobo, bas malaqash fuloos kiteer.

examples.english: The problem is I don't have a lot of money
examples.transliteration: el moshkela en maandish felous keteer

examples.english: I paid money and said thank you to the seller.
examples.transliteration: Dafa't felous w olt shokran lel baya'.

examples.english: I have a lot of money to buy.
